description: This header file declares the ServicePrioritizationUtils_tc class, which extends the ServicePrioritizationUtils class to provide utility functions for service prioritization. It includes methods for flushing rules, applying maps for DSCP, UP, and single values, and managing qdiscs on network interfaces.

classes.name: ServicePrioritizationUtils_tc
classes.description: A utility class for service prioritization, extending the base ServicePrioritizationUtils with additional functionalities specific to certain test cases or configurations. It manages rules and interface configurations for network prioritization.

methods.name: ~ServicePrioritizationUtils_tc
methods.description: Destructor that clears all rules and cleans up the utility class instance.

methods.name: flush_rules
methods.description: Overrides to clear all prioritization rules.

methods.name: apply_single_value_map
methods.description: Applies a mapping of interface tags to a single value, such as setting a PCP value across interfaces.

methods.name: apply_dscp_map
methods.description: Applies a DSCP mapping to interfaces, optionally with a default PCP.

methods.name: apply_up_map
methods.description: Applies the UP map to interfaces, optionally with a default PCP.

methods.name: add_qdisc
methods.description: Adds a qdisc to the specified network interface.

methods.name: remove_qdisc
methods.description: Removes the qdisc from the specified network interface.
